name: United Tiger Match Jersey
short_description: The official United Tigers match jersey for the 2026 Abu Dhabi T10. All-over TIGERS print in purple and pink, United Tigers crest, Jersey Terminal mark, and Pak Crick centre sponsor — shown on squad players.
description:
The official United Tigers match jersey for the 2026 Abu Dhabi T10. An all-over TIGERS print in purple and pink, with the United Tigers crest on the left chest, Jersey Terminal on the right, Pak Crick as centre sponsor, gold side stripes and pink cuff trim.

  • Official match kit for Abu Dhabi T10 2026
  • All-over TIGERS print in purple and pink
  • United Tigers crest + Jersey Terminal branding
  • Squad player photography gallery
  • Sizes S–XXL
